hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler vault liquidity. All swap accounting is handled entirely within beforeSwap via BeforeSwapReturnsDelta: input tokens are taken into Euler vaults and output tokens withdrawn from them, with a custom curve invariant verified after each swap to enforce pricing. Standard CLAMM liquidity positions, direct donations, and external pool initialization are all blocked.
